name: Ichinose Mio
source: Mio is [url=/c18180]Yuuma's[/url] childhood friend and the daughter of a shrine family. She is an honest, gentle girl, but also has a profound fear regarding the opposite sex. Due to that constitution, it makes her unable to have any physical contact with men, however, Yuuma helps her with rehabilitation by holding hands with her on the way to school every day. Mio is also a closet pervert and likes BL. She often has weird delusions when confronted with suggestive situations.
